question.text: Per Chapter 6, the INCENTIVE FEE (carry / performance fee) charged by Cat I/II AIF managers is generally in what range?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 6 states incentive fees are 'generally between 0 and 20 percent' of the incremental return earned by the AIF, computed per PPM methodology. 20% is the global market standard. The Trap: B is unrealistic; C confuses carry with management fee base; D is absurd. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests same range. Internationally same 20% standard; INR hurdle tends higher than USD hurdle (8-10% vs 5-8%). Manager's Pro-Tip: Some super-successful GPs negotiate tiered carry: 20% up to 2.5x MOIC, 25% thereafter. SEBI does not cap carry — PPM disclosure is the governance anchor. Align tiering with LP expectations; don't surprise them at distribution.
